rule: GOAL: Guide the purple token along the dotted path to the blue circle at the top. CONTROLS: Click any dot within three steps to swap the token instantly; clicking farther does nothing. RULE: The token can only jump up to three path segments per click, allowing rapid traversal. TRAP: Assuming unlimited jump range wastes moves; clicks beyond distance three are invalid and fail silently.

GOAL: Move the yellow key to the target slot by adjusting the gray wall's position. CONTROLS: Clicking blue blocks shifts the wall edges horizontally to open paths for the key. RULE: The wall edges move in opposite directions; one expands while the other contracts. TRAP: Assuming clicks move the key directly wastes time; they only reconfigure the maze walls.

GOAL: Reach the green exit cell on the checkerboard pattern. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player two squares at a time. RULE: Movement hops over gray squares, landing only on white ones. TRAP: Thinking you can stop on a gray square wastes turns.

GOAL: Extend rods until their tip dots reach the plus markers. CONTROLS: Right-clicks on a rod extend it by three units. RULE: Green dots sit one unit before the tip; yellow dots sit exactly at the tip. TRAP: Assuming dots are at the absolute end wastes moves; green needs one extra step to cover the target.

GOAL: Place three boxes into the frame's slots to complete the level. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player and carry attached boxes; Space toggles attachment when adjacent. RULE: Boxes stick only when the player faces them and presses Space, then follow the player's movements. TRAP: Thinking boxes stay put after moving; they slide along with you until detached, so plan paths carefully.

GOAL: Align the three gray blades so their left edges form a single vertical column, creating a clear path to the key. CONTROLS: Four blue buttons on the left shift specific gray blades horizontally; clicking moves them one unit in a set direction. RULE: The top and bottom blades move in opposite directions to the middle blade when their respective paired buttons are pressed. TRAP: Assuming all buttons move the same blade; two buttons actually control the middle blade while the others control the outer blades.

GOAL: Pour liquid from the plunger into the waiting cups. CONTROLS: Use arrows to position the spout and space to release the flow. RULE: Liquid spreads along surfaces before falling, so aim for the center of the bar to split the stream evenly. TRAP: Thinking the splash was a failure animation wasted time; it was just the liquid hitting the bottom, not a game over.

GOAL: Guide the plug into the socket by moving it straight down five spaces. CONTROLS: Click slots to toggle black or white, setting move directions. Click the ball to run the sequence. RULE: Black pairs mean down. White pairs mean stop. Set all slots to black for a straight drop. TRAP: Thinking white meant up. It actually means no movement, causing the plug to stall.

GOAL: Match each pink glyph to its legend partner using the blue row as a guide. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; UP cycles the current glyph through its shape variants. RULE: The blue glyph in a column dictates which pink glyph from the legend is correct. TRAP: Assuming rotation affects the match; the game only checks shape identity, not orientation.

GOAL: Make the lit cells match the pattern to drain the ball’s energy to zero. CONTROLS: Arrows move the ball; pressing lit cells toggles their state to match the target. RULE: The circuit only closes when the green cells exactly equal the required diamond shape. TRAP: Thinking the goal was to keep the ball large; actually, you must shrink it by completing the circuit.

GOAL: Cross the grid to the exit while avoiding a lethal hazard. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one tile per press. RULE: The hazard dashes horizontally when you enter its line of sight. TRAP: Thinking you could step directly into the hazard’s tile to neutralize it.

GOAL: Guide the shrinking ball through the narrow shaft into the upper chamber. CONTROLS: Click keypad dots to match the card pattern, triggering a size reduction. Use arrow keys to move the ball upward through the gap. RULE: The ball must shrink to fit the two-wide shaft before attempting to ascend. TRAP: Attempting to move the full-sized ball into the narrow gap wastes time, as it cannot pass until the surge triggers.

GOAL: Deliver the crate to the left slot without hitting the moving guard. CONTROLS: Arrows move you and push attached crates; Space toggles carrying the crate overhead. RULE: Crates stay attached above you until you press Space again, regardless of facing direction. TRAP: Assuming you must face the crate to detach it; Space releases it from directly above instantly.

GOAL: Lower the green pillar to the target line while keeping purple and yellow pillars steady. CONTROLS: Click buttons between pillars to shift water up or down by two units, moving mass to the neighbor. RULE: A button is blocked if it pushes any pillar past its top or bottom limit, even if the other pillar has room. TRAP: Assuming all buttons work freely; ignoring the tight upper limit on the middle pillar causes wasted clicks and confusion.

GOAL: Rotate shapes at each bracket position to match target symbols using minimal presses. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cursor between positions; pressing an arrow rotates the shape at the current position. RULE: Shapes cycle in a fixed order, so choose the direction requiring fewer presses to reach the target. TRAP: Assuming all shapes cycle in the same direction or order wastes actions on inefficient rotations.

ESTABLISHED: The collection order is fixed by the tray, not your choice. Only the first item is currently active. FAILED: Attempting to collect the second item directly results in rejection, regardless of position. GOAL IS NOT: Collecting items in any order you prefer. CONTROLS: Move the hook to the active target’s exact location to collect it, then proceed to the next.

GOAL: Decode yellow glyphs to find blue lengths, then cycle blue slots to match the hidden target string. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor left or right; pressing up or down cycles the current glyph through its shape states. RULE: Each yellow glyph maps to a blue word length, forcing a unique segmentation of the blue row to reveal the target. TRAP: Assuming all glyphs share the same cycle length wastes time; each slot has a unique period that must be discovered individually.

GOAL: Decode the hidden word by cycling glyphs to match the target sequence. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor and cycle the selected glyph. RULE: The yellow legend defines the word order, while the blue strip provides the specific glyph patterns. TRAP: Assuming a fixed cycle length; you must adaptively learn the rotation direction and period for each position.

GOAL: Capture four directional traps without triggering them, then reach the exit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one step; landing on a trap captures it permanently. RULE: Traps fire only if you are within two squares directly in front of their facing direction. TRAP: Assuming distance alone triggers danger; traps ignore you if you are behind or to the side, regardless of proximity.

GOAL: Arrange colored squares to match a fixed target sequence shown at the top of the screen. CONTROLS: Click a colored square in the bottom tray to select it, then click an empty slot in the middle row to place it. RULE: The sequence of placed colors must exactly match the order displayed in the top row to complete the level. TRAP: Assuming the tray order matches the target order; the tray arrangement is shuffled and requires manual sorting.

GOAL: Align two colored crosses to cover four scattered dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active cross; Space switches control between yellow and blue crosses. RULE: A dot is cleared only when a cross arm passes directly over it. TRAP: Assuming dots vanish immediately upon contact; they remain visible until the cross moves away, hiding the state change.

GOAL: Align three shapes so their lines cover all colored dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space cycles which shape is active. RULE: Dots vanish when a shape’s line passes over them, merging with the line color. TRAP: Believing dots remain visible if covered; they actually disappear into the line, misleading you about alignment.

GOAL: Reduce the board to a single remaining peg. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click an empty space two steps away to jump and remove the jumped-over peg. RULE: A move is valid only if the landing spot is empty and the intermediate spot holds a peg. TRAP: Thinking you can jump into occupied spots or skip over empty spaces; every jump must capture exactly one neighbor.

GOAL: Arrange colored blocks to match a hidden sequence defined by the visual flow path. CONTROLS: Click two slots to swap contents; press space to validate the current arrangement. RULE: The check highlights only the first mismatch in the pipe's flow order, not spatial left-to-right. TRAP: Assuming slot order follows screen layout wastes time; the flow jumps from the top row to the bottom row immediately.

GOAL: Guide the gray diamond into the target ring. CONTROLS: Click empty space to move the white cursor. Click a piece to swap it with the cursor. RULE: Swapping places the selected piece exactly where the cursor stood. TRAP: Clicking the gray piece first moves the cursor, not the diamond.

GOAL: Rotate the ring until the yellow tile sits under the top bracket. CONTROLS: Red clicks spin the ring clockwise; green clicks spin it counter-clockwise. RULE: Each click advances the ring by one position, so five reds align the target. TRAP: Assuming you must click the tile or bracket directly instead of using the side arrows.

GOAL: Fill all seven open slots by placing letters in the correct sequence. CONTROLS: Click a letter from the bottom tray to select it, then click a slot to place it. Press space to submit your solution. RULE: Read left to right; when you hit a framed slot, fill the attached box below completely before continuing the main row. TRAP: Assuming framed slots are empty. They are blocked paths that trigger a detour into the colored boxes below.

GOAL: Move three shapes to cover all eight dots on the grid. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active shape; Space cycles to the next shape. RULE: Shapes follow a strict cycle order, so plan moves to minimize Space presses. TRAP: Assuming shapes move independently ignores the cycle, forcing extra Space presses to return to a desired shape.

GOAL: Fill seven slots using seven tokens while respecting a hidden traversal order. CONTROLS: Click tray tokens to select, then click grid slots to place. Space confirms or resets. RULE: Placing a frame token makes a slot unfillable and redirects the sequence into the attached green box. TRAP: Assuming linear left-to-right filling ignores the frame’s role as a bridge, causing misplaced colors.

GOAL: Place seven tokens into red and green slots to match the legend order. CONTROLS: Click tray token, click slot to place; click placed item to remove; Space to check. RULE: The frame token marks the link point; traversal dives into the green box at that specific red slot position. TRAP: Placing the frame elsewhere breaks the sequence, as the pre-filled green token hints the dive must occur at the third red slot.

GOAL: Fill red slots and a blue box so two dives through the box yield identical color sequences. CONTROLS: Click pieces onto slots; press space to check. RULE: The blue box contents must match exactly in both passes to validate the frame placement. TRAP: Assuming frames can be anywhere; they must be adjacent to force the specific overlapping dive pattern.

GOAL: Make the active panel's blocks match the surrounding ring's color pattern. CONTROLS: Click a block to toggle its color between blue and red. RULE: The ring acts as a fixed target; only the highlighted panel changes when clicked. TRAP: Assuming the ring updates with the blocks; it stays constant, serving only as the solution key.

GOAL: Place blocks so colors match the legend, using frames to shift positions. CONTROLS: Click to drag pieces and frames to slots; press Space to verify the solution. RULE: Frames act as spacers, pushing subsequent blocks to align the green piece with the legend. TRAP: Assuming blocks must fill every slot immediately; empty spaces are necessary to reach the correct alignment.

GOAL: Merge both blue blocks into a single unit at the top center. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move blocks; Space activates the merge when adjacent. RULE: Blocks only combine if they occupy the same target cell simultaneously. TRAP: Assuming arrows control blocks independently; they move as a linked pair.

GOAL: Reach the marked target to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the character one step in that direction. RULE: The plus sign indicates the exact destination required for victory. TRAP: Do not assume the directional pointer updates live; it is a static hint, not a real-time guide.

GOAL: Match each spinner’s ring pattern to its neighboring blocks by setting blocks to orange. CONTROLS: Click blocks to toggle between blue and orange; click spinner centers to rotate rings. RULE: Ring segments marked white require adjacent orange blocks; gray segments require blue blocks. TRAP: Assuming rings are static targets caused conflict; they actually rotate to resolve shared neighbor clashes.

GOAL: Position two yellow pieces onto their matching bracket targets to complete the puzzle. CONTROLS: Clicking the top green arrow moves the first piece; clicking the bottom green arrow moves the second. RULE: Each arrow click advances only its corresponding piece, requiring careful sequencing to align both simultaneously. TRAP: Assuming one click moves all pieces or that order doesn't matter leads to wasted moves and failure.

GOAL: Move the orange cross onto the target dots to turn it green. CONTROLS: Arrows move the shape; space switches between the cross and the plus. RULE: The shape’s color changes only when it fully covers the matching dots. TRAP: The gray border does not block movement or change the shape’s color; ignore it.

GOAL: Set every cell to orange or red based on the four surrounding spinner rings. CONTROLS: Clicking a cell toggles its color. RULE: White ring tiles match the spinner's center color; gray tiles show the opposite color. TRAP: Assuming gray always means orange fails when a spinner has a red center, requiring you to flip your logic for those rings.

GOAL: Slide two blocks until they fully overlap on a safe spot. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move blocks four units; blocked walls stop movement. RULE: Landing on red hazards resets both blocks to the start immediately. TRAP: Assuming walls only block movement; hazards are passable but trigger resets.

GOAL: Assign correct colors to a grid of blocks to satisfy hidden constraints. CONTROLS: Clicking a block cycles its color through the available palette in a fixed order. RULE: Each click advances the color one step in the sequence, requiring multiple clicks to reach the target hue. TRAP: Assuming one click per block; some colors require two or more clicks to cycle into place, wasting actions.

ESTABLISHED: The W-dot block knocks the dark block. The dark block moves into the wall. The wall is passable via knock. FAILED: Self-moving the dark block into the wall. Self-moving the W-dot block into the wall. GOAL IS NOT: Placing blocks in the left room. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the W-dot block. Moving adjacent to the dark block knocks it one step in that direction.

ESTABLISHED: The maze is a spiral of black corridors. A two-state snake blocks the left path at (38,14). The exit is in the bottom corridor. FAILED: Waiting for the snake to move permanently. Walking through the blocked path. Pressing SPACE to reset the snake state. GOAL IS NOT: Reaching the white background areas or the snake’s current head position. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player. SPACE teleports you to the start, resetting the snake’s position.

GOAL: Slide the plug into the green socket by aligning its prongs with the side tabs. CONTROLS: Arrows move the plug; Space rotates it. RULE: The plug must rotate so prongs face right before sliding into the socket. TRAP: Assuming the plug fits without rotating causes it to hit the side tabs and stop.

GOAL: Route two distinct tiles to their target positions by rotating interconnected loops. CONTROLS: Click left or right loops to rotate them clockwise or counterclockwise. RULE: Shared tiles move along the path of the specific loop you rotate, not both simultaneously. TRAP: Assuming rotations affect all tiles equally; ignoring independent tile trajectories caused excessive trial and error.

GOAL: Make all blocks match their required color while satisfying every spinner's directional rule. CONTROLS: Clicking a block cycles its color; clicking a spinner rotates its four directional tiles. RULE: Spinner constraints apply to adjacent cells, including the central cross blocks, not just outer blocks. TRAP: Assuming cross blocks were immune to spinner rules caused wasted moves fixing outer blocks first.

GOAL: Reach the exit after the snake clears its path. CONTROLS: Arrows move your character through the maze. RULE: A ghost replays your exact steps, holding a button to move the snake. TRAP: Thinking the ghost stops after the replay; it loops, so time your entry precisely.

GOAL: Move the black shape so its mirrored reflection perfectly overlaps the yellow target zone. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the piece; the mirror flips its position horizontally across the center line. RULE: Since the reflection flips left and right, move the piece to the opposite side of where the yellow shape appears. TRAP: Assuming the reflection matches the yellow shape’s actual position, causing you to move toward the visible target instead of away from it.

ESTABLISHED: The grid holds nine knob positions; red and blue toggles are independent of the knob's location. FAILED: Clicking plugs while sweeping the knob through all nine positions in various combinations triggered no win. GOAL IS NOT: Matching plug states to the static T-shape icons on the right panel. CONTROLS: Clicking red or blue switches that plug's state; arrow keys move the 2x2 knob within the 6x6 green box.
GOAL: Reach the far corner using limited moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the player two spaces. RULE: Movement stops only when hitting a wall. TRAP: Assuming moves are single steps wastes actions.

GOAL: Align the plug’s yellow handle with the gap, then insert it upward. CONTROLS: Left clicks moved the plug horizontally; clicking the plug lifted it when aligned. RULE: Colors must match exactly; the yellow handle fills the yellow gap. TRAP: Assuming the charcoal prong was the target wasted moves on the wrong alignment.

GOAL: Move the plug handle right to align with the target marker in the second bar. CONTROLS: Click the top blue pair to shift white fluid between chambers; click the bottom blue pair to push the plug right. RULE: The top piston transfers fluid from the top chamber to the middle chamber, creating the pressure needed for movement. TRAP: Clicking the wrong top piston button drains the middle chamber, stalling the plug instead of advancing it.

GOAL: Match five blue target glyphs by rotating corresponding pink dials into alignment. CONTROLS: Left and right arrows move the selection cursor; up and down arrows rotate the current dial forward or backward through its cycle. RULE: Each dial cycles through seven specific glyphs; rotate each until it exactly matches its designated blue target. TRAP: Assuming all glyphs in the cycle appear in the legend; one unique glyph exists, causing confusion if treated as an error rather than a valid option.

GOAL: Push blocks into the bar’s empty slots to complete the row. CONTROLS: Arrows move and rotate the player; Space attaches or detaches a block. RULE: A block snaps into a slot only when pushed directly into it from the adjacent side. TRAP: Detached blocks stay attached until you press Space again; assuming they auto-drop wastes moves.

GOAL: Position a piece and a mirror so the piece’s reflection exactly fills the yellow target shape. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected object; Space switches selection between the piece and the mirror. RULE: The reflection mirrors horizontally across the mirror’s line, so the mirror must sit at the axis of symmetry. TRAP: Moving the mirror while the piece is selected moves the piece instead, causing wasted actions if selection isn’t switched first.

GOAL: Align five rotating number dials to match the target sequence. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the selected dial forward or backward through the fixed cycle. RULE: Each dial follows the same hidden order, so knowing the full sequence lets you calculate the shortest path. TRAP: Pressing buttons blindly to guess positions wastes moves; learn the complete cycle order once to solve every dial efficiently.

ESTABLISHED: Two presses at identical tilt angles produce different dye patterns, proving the piston shifts position after every action. FAILED: Pressing twice at the same tilt failed to replicate the first result or clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: A static piston or simple geometric overlap. CONTROLS: Pressing extends the piston, but it does not return to the exact original coordinates.

ESTABLISHED: Three green nodes exist at specific coordinates. Clearing them dissolves a horizontal water barrier above. FAILED: Moving left or staying put keeps the player trapped below the barrier. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching the middle room or opening the barrier alone. CONTROLS: Clicking nodes removes water. Right moves shift the player right. Rising moves the player up through open water columns.

GOAL: Translate the yellow glyph sequence into the correct blue glyph sequence by applying the legend's substitution rules. CONTROLS: Arrow keys navigate between slots and rotate the glyph in the selected slot through its cycle. RULE: Each yellow word maps to a specific blue word; the total number of blue slots must match the sum of the target word lengths. TRAP: Assuming the blue row starts with correct glyphs wastes actions; verify every slot against the calculated target sequence before rotating.

GOAL: Place two black shapes to cover yellow targets by matching hole positions. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; Space switches selection between pieces. RULE: A piece is selected when all its holes appear white, confirming alignment. TRAP: Assuming a piece is selected because it looks placed; check hole colors to verify.
GOAL: Reach the exit in three moves. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player one step. RULE: Guards charge only when you enter their column. TRAP: Thinking the guard was a static wall.

GOAL: Match the yellow row to the sky row using a two-step color chain. CONTROLS: Arrows cycle the glyph in the selected slot. RULE: Sky maps to pink, which maps to yellow, requiring two substitutions per letter. TRAP: Assuming a direct sky-to-yellow map ignores the pink middle step, causing endless wrong cycles.

GOAL: Make the plug drop into the socket below the glyphs. CONTROLS: Click glyphs to toggle their horizontal bars black or white; click the circle to run the drop. RULE: The plug descends one step for every black horizontal bar currently lit. TRAP: Changing the vertical stems does not affect the drop height; only the bars matter.

GOAL: Reach the top exit by navigating through wall channels and rising vertically. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player horizontally; the player automatically rises when water or open space is above. RULE: You can only rise through openings in the walls, not through solid barriers. TRAP: Thinking you must clear green blocks in the middle; the right channel provides a direct path upward.

GOAL: Move sand between five bars to match specific height targets for the first, fourth, and fifth columns. CONTROLS: Click the left or right button under a bar to move two units of sand to the adjacent neighbor. RULE: Sand flows strictly from left to right when the left button is pressed, and right to left for the right button. TRAP: Assuming you can move sand from the first bar to the left or the last bar to the right, which is impossible.

GOAL: Drop the mirror to align reflections with yellow targets, then slide two black pieces right to cover them. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece or mirror. Space cycles selection between the mirror and the two blocks. RULE: Mirrors pass through colored zones freely, but solid blocks must land precisely on yellow areas to count. TRAP: Assuming moving the mirror changes the active selection; it does not, so pressing Space immediately is required to switch to a block.

GOAL: Slide the square to the far corner along the diagonal. CONTROLS: Click a target cell to jump the square toward it. RULE: You can only move up to six grid steps per turn. TRAP: Believing the dotted line shifts; it stays fixed, hiding only under the square.

GOAL: Move the blue platform to catch a falling plug. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the blue platform; Space releases the plug. RULE: The plug falls straight down, so the platform must be positioned to deflect or catch it into a cup. TRAP: Assuming arrows move the plug directly; they only move the platform, requiring careful timing of the release.

GOAL: Match every panel’s displayed number to its target value. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the cursor to select a panel; pressing a button cycled that panel’s value. RULE: Multi-slot panels changed as a single unit, requiring the pair to match the target simultaneously. TRAP: Assuming slots cycled independently caused wasted moves; they always moved together.

GOAL: Navigate to the exit tile without triggering the guard's vision cone. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the character one step in that direction. RULE: Guards only attack directly ahead; lateral movement is always safe. TRAP: Assuming guards see in all directions or follow you; they are blind to their sides.

GOAL: Arrange the bottom colored plugs into the top tray slots to match the target sequence displayed above. CONTROLS: Click a bottom plug to select it, then click a tray slot to swap their positions. Press space to submit your arrangement. RULE: Each tray slot accepts exactly one plug, swapping the slot’s current gray dot down to the bottom row. TRAP: Pressing space before filling all slots with matching colors causes immediate failure on the first empty or mismatched position.

GOAL: Align the plug with the target zone using mirror logic. CONTROLS: Clicks toggled glyph segments; circle executed the move. RULE: The diagram showed the target position as a left-right mirror of the board state. TRAP: Assuming the diagram showed the current plug location instead of the mirrored goal.

GOAL: Guide the shrinking plug block to the socket by aligning its prongs with the panel's pins. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the block along the channel; movements rotate the block's orientation in place. RULE: The block halves in size after contacting the energy panel, allowing it to fit the tighter socket. TRAP: Assuming the block stays full-size; ignoring the split mechanism leaves you stuck in the wide channel.

GOAL: Shrink the block to fit the narrow neck and slide it up to the handle. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the block; keypad clicks toggled cells to change the block's size. RULE: The lit pattern on the keypad defined the block's new shape, allowing it to pass through tight spaces. TRAP: Assuming the block could fit the neck at its original width, wasting time trying to force it through before shrinking.

GOAL: Align red dots to plus centers. CONTROLS: Click green glyph to extend right; click yellow glyph to extend down. RULE: Each click moves the dot exactly three units. TRAP: Assuming the bar tip must touch the plus; the red dot must reach the center hole.

GOAL: Move the yellow and blue crosses to their unique center positions so their arms cover all matching dots. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active cross; Space switches between yellow and blue. RULE: A cross covers dots only when its row and column arms align perfectly with them. TRAP: Assuming any valid alignment works; only one specific coordinate satisfies both row and column constraints simultaneously.

GOAL: Merge two parts to form a Y-shape inside the target circle. CONTROLS: Click to move a piece one step in a direction. RULE: Pieces merge when close; the new shape forms at the moving piece's location. TRAP: Assuming the merge happens instantly at contact; you must push the moving piece into the stationary one's zone to trigger the formation.

GOAL: Route four colored plugs into matching sockets by tracing pipes through boxes. CONTROLS: Click to select a plug, Space to send it down the current pipe. RULE: Sockets check plugs in strict left-to-right order; a mismatch blocks all later sockets. TRAP: Assuming the pipe enters the green box at the visible hole; it actually checks the far-left slot first.

GOAL: Place the midpoint blob at the ring center. CONTROLS: Click empty cells to move the white piece; click the gray piece to swap positions. RULE: The blob forms exactly at the midpoint between the white and gray pieces. TRAP: Assuming you can move the gray piece directly; it only relocates by swapping with the white piece.

GOAL: Fill seven sockets by routing a single signal through a red track that branches into two color-coded boxes at specific junctions. CONTROLS: Click bottom plugs to select them, then click empty sockets to insert them; press space to test the circuit. RULE: At each junction, the signal drops into the corresponding box and fills its slots left-to-right before returning to the main track. TRAP: Assuming plugs match their color or slot number; sockets fill strictly by traversal order, so a red plug might land in a green slot.

ESTABLISHED: Blue is permanently hooked to the wire tip; it follows every move. FAILED: Vertical moves did not release the block; the hook remains sticky. GOAL IS NOT: Simply pushing blue right; it has been dragged right since the first move. CONTROLS: RIGHT pushes blue right. LEFT pulls blue left. UP and DOWN move blue vertically while attached.

GOAL: Guide colored markers to cover matching dots on the grid. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active marker; Spacebar cycles which marker is active. RULE: A level ends only when every dot is covered by its corresponding color. TRAP: Assuming Spacebar is free or instant; it consumes action budget and cycles in a strict order, not randomly.

GOAL: Position the plug to match the legend's required orientation. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug one step per press. RULE: Stepping on the plus marker flips the legend's stem direction. TRAP: Assuming the legend is a live minimap; it is actually a state indicator triggered by switches.

GOAL: Fit the block into the narrow tube. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the block; submitting code triggered a pulse in the last pressed direction. RULE: The pulse pushed and squeezed the block toward that direction. TRAP: Thinking the pulse ignored the last arrow; pressing wrong directions wasted moves.

GOAL: Guide the green chain to the plus target by extending segments around purple obstacles. CONTROLS: Click directional glyphs to extend chain segments in specific directions. RULE: Green segments grow downward only, requiring careful routing to avoid purple bars. TRAP: Assuming purple pieces are passable ghosts; they are solid walls blocking the path.

GOAL: Align the yellow block with the fixed bracket marker. CONTROLS: One button rotates the entire ring clockwise; the other rotates it counter-clockwise. RULE: The puzzle ends when the unique yellow tile sits exactly inside the yellow bracket. TRAP: Believing you must click individual tiles to move them; only the global rotation controls matter.

GOAL: Cover every scattered dot using a sliding bar, an X, and a diamond. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active shape; Spacebar cycles which shape is active. RULE: The level ends only when all dots are hidden beneath the shapes. TRAP: Moving shapes over dots does not count as covering; they must stop on top.

ESTABLISHED: Two 5x5 squares sit on a grid, moving in 5-column steps along a connected arch path. They are currently separated by a gap. FAILED: Moving them to become adjacent at columns 29-33 and 34-38 did not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply placing the two squares side-by-side in the center of the top bar. CONTROLS: Left and Right inputs move both squares simultaneously along the path; invalid moves are ignored.

GOAL: Slide the corridor plug into the left socket to complete the pair. CONTROLS: Click to select a plug; use arrow keys to move it in three-cell steps. RULE: The ring is passable, so slides only stop at walls or when a plug lands adjacent to its target socket. TRAP: Assuming the ring blocks movement or that a pushed plug stops mid-grid; it actually slides until catching the socket.

GOAL: Paint the plus orange by touching the correct swatch, then position both shapes to cover target dots without interference. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; SPACE switches between the plus and the X. RULE: Order matters: move horizontally before vertically to avoid touching unintended swatches during transit. TRAP: Assuming the final position is safe while ignoring intermediate collisions with other swatches causes wrong colors.

GOAL: Align two yellow blocks into the target column slots. CONTROLS: Click red plugs to shift blocks forward or backward. Click green plugs to shift them the opposite way. RULE: Each click moves one block exactly one step along its specific track, cycling through positions. TRAP: Assuming clicks affect all blocks simultaneously. They do not; each plug controls only its designated track, requiring careful sequencing.

GOAL: Change the highlighted panel's red cell to match the target pattern. CONTROLS: Clicking a colored cell toggles its state between red and blue. RULE: Only the currently highlighted panel responds to clicks; others remain static. TRAP: Believing any panel can be edited at any time wastes actions on inactive grids.

GOAL: Guide two squares to sit side-by-side in the bottom row. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both squares simultaneously in that direction. RULE: Squares slide until they hit a wall or obstacle; they do not stop mid-grid. TRAP: Believing you can position squares individually or stop them freely; they always travel to the edge.

GOAL: Clear the board to one peg. CONTROLS: Click a peg to see its jump preview, then click the destination to move. RULE: Pegs jump over adjacent neighbors to land two spaces away, removing the jumped peg. TRAP: Assuming complex geometry; simple straight-line jumps solve it quickly.

GOAL: Change the puzzle grid to match the target color pattern. CONTROLS: Click only the center of colored tiles to toggle them; background gaps and blue border blocks are inert. RULE: Only clickable tiles respond; precise targeting of the tile center is required for action. GOAL: Align the plug vertically with the red block to trigger a swap. CONTROLS: Arrows move the plug; the red block chases along the axis. RULE: Moving toward an aligned block swaps positions, clearing the path. TRAP: Assuming proximity alone triggers movement; alignment and direction matter.

GOAL: Raise the floating block to the yellow marker in channel three. CONTROLS: Click left buttons to push water between adjacent channels.
